app.notes:
The Guide melody now works like a karaoke machine: it sets only the melody channel, and nothing else in the song
New setting: Settings, Sound, Melody Channel. Most songs keep the melody on Channel 1; choose Channel 4 if yours are there
A song can no longer change the melody's level by itself, so Melody 0 or Guide off takes it out, and each step sounds the same in every song
Scores follow the part that carries the tune, even when a song file names another part as the lead
